subtitles.en: The hidden sayings of the living Jesus — the incipit and 114 logia of Nag Hammadi Codex II,2

descriptions.en: **Planned** Wheel of Heaven Translation of the Gospel of Thomas from the Sahidic Coptic of Nag Hammadi Codex II,2 — the Coptic-language pilot of the Translation Program. Source layer taken from the Coptic Scriptorium thomas-gospel corpus (Paul C. Dilley's born-digital edition, CC BY 4.0), preserving the diplomatic bound groups with supralinear strokes and editorial sigla. One chapter of 115 verses: the incipit (n=0, kept apart from logion 1 per the corpus division) plus the standard 114 logia. The manuscript's Coptic title is the closing subscript ⲡⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲟⲛ ⲡⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲑⲱⲙⲁⲥ ('The Gospel according to Thomas').
